items.title: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) Joined A Quantum Error Correction Platform Launch
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (NasdaqGS:AMD) joined IBM and Oak Ridge National Laboratory to launch a new quantum error correction co-design platform. The effort links IBM quantum hardware with AMD high performance classical processors inside Oak Ridge National Laboratory’s research environment. The collaboration aligns with the U.S. Department of Energy’s Quantum Genesis Mission and focuses on hybrid quantum classical computing research.
